hook_line: RAMAYANA CROSSES RS 900 CRORE WORLDWIDE IN FIRST WEEK

hook_stat.sub: Worldwide gross in the first week, crossed on Day 7

stats.label: Day 7 India net by Sacnilk's estimates, above the opening day
India net total in seven days, past the Rs 500 crore mark

diaspora_bullets: Overseas markets added about Rs 323.50 crore gross in the first week
Diaspora audiences in North America, the UK, the Gulf and Australia carried much of the run
news_summary: Ramayana: Part 1, a Hindi-language mythological epic directed by Nitesh Tiwari, crossed Rs 900 crore in worldwide gross in its first week, with Day 7 India net of Rs 70.65 crore above its opening day.
payoff: As a theatrical event for Indian audiences worldwide, the first week has no recent precedent.
